# operation: # create, insert_blank_page (page_width=, page_height=; default A4), draw_image with the arguments, save, reopen, then read=:
# matrix: the six operands a b c d e f of the CTM in effect at the Do painting the image, relative to the page's default user
#   space (ISO 32000-2:2020, 8.3.4, 8.4.4 cm); each number rounded to 4 fraction digits, trailing zeros and point dropped, -0 as 0.
# size: Width Height; bits: BitsPerComponent (8.9.5.1); filter: the Filter names space-separated, or none (7.4).
# color_space: DeviceGray, DeviceRGB, DeviceCMYK, ICCBased N, or Indexed <base> <hival> <lookup bytes as lowercase hex> (8.6).
# raw_sha256: of the image stream's stored bytes; samples_sha256: of its bytes decoded through every filter (8.9.3 layout: rows
#   packed MSB-first, each padded to a byte, 16-bit samples big-endian); mask_samples_sha256: the same of its SMask, or none;
#   icc_sha256: of the decoded ICCBased profile stream, or none. Hashes are SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4), lowercase hex.
# ISO 32000-2:2020, 7.4.8: a JPEG (ITU-T T.81 baseline SOF0 or progressive SOF2) is embedded with its bytes unchanged under DCTDecode;
#   1, 3 or 4 components give DeviceGray, DeviceRGB or DeviceCMYK (8.9.5.1). The CMYK files carry an Adobe APP14 marker, transform 0,
#   and store inverted values, so their image dictionaries need Decode [1 0 1 0 1 0 1 0] (8.9.5.2).
# A format given is used instead of detection
# ISO/IEC 15948:2004, 6.1, 11.2.2 (Table 11.1): every colour type and bit depth, non-interlaced and Adam7-interlaced (8.2), with
#   rows using every filter type (9.2) and IDAT split over chunks (11.2.4), decodes losslessly; 16-bit samples stay 16-bit
#   (ISO 32000-2:2020, 8.9.5.1). Colour type 3 gives Indexed with hival the PLTE entries less one (8.6.6.3, 11.2.3); colour types
#   4 and 6 give their alpha channel as an SMask of the image's bit depth (8.9.5.1, 11.6.5.3). Some interlaced images have
# ISO/IEC 15948:2004, 11.3.2.1: tRNS gives an SMask of 8 bits per sample (ISO 32000-2:2020, 11.6.5.3): for colour types 0 and 2
#   0 where a pixel equals the key (all 16 bits compared) and 255 elsewhere; for colour type 3 the entry's alpha, 255 past its end.
# ISO 32000-2:2020, 8.6.5.5: an embedded ICC profile (ICC.1, made for these tests) is kept as ICCBased: JPEG APP2 ICC_PROFILE
#   segments (ICC.1:2010, B.4), here also split over two, and the PNG iCCP chunk (ISO/IEC 15948:2004, 11.3.3.3).
# Placement, ISO 32000-2:2020, 8.3.2.3, 8.9.4: x, y are the image's top-left corner in points from the top-left of the displayed page;
#   both sizes stretch, one keeps the ratio, none puts 1 pixel on 1 point (72 DPI). baseline-rgb.jpg is 13x9, c2-b8.png 9x6.
# Exif 2.32 (CIPA DC-008-2019), 4.6.4 A, tag 274 Orientation, in JPEG APP1 (big-endian TIFF header for even values, little-endian for
#   odd) and the PNG eXIf chunk: the image is drawn as oriented; width and height are of the oriented image; the samples and JPEG
#   bytes stay as stored. Stored 6x4, so 5 to 8 display 4x6. On a 200x100 page at 10, 20 the displayed box is x 10..10+W, y 80-H..80.
# Another format is Unsupported; a damaged image, or one not of the format given, is Malformed: a JPEG cut inside SOF0
#   (ITU-T T.81, B.2.2), a PNG whose zlib data holds the reserved deflate block type 3 (RFC 1951, 3.2.3)
